newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Spain's Santander to stock list Banco Rio shortly.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Santander to stock list Banco Rio shortly.

text.p: Spanish bank Santander and Sudacia SA, the holding company of Argentina's Banco Rio de la Plata, intend to stock list Banco Rio in Buenos Aires and New York shortly.

"Sudacia SA and Santander expect shortly to carry out a public offering of stocks of Banco Rio at the Buenos Aires and New York stock exchanges," Banco Rio said in a press release Tuesday, following the purchase of Banco Rio by Santander announced earlier.
The statement gave no further details of the stock listing.
Santander said it would pay $594 million for 35.06 percent of Banco Rio's share capital with an option for an additional 15 percent. The initial stake provides voting control of the bank.
Santander will merge Rio with its Banco Santander Argentina unit, creating the largest bank in the country with assets in excess of $10 billion.
